title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 3+1+2 + VERANDE + PARKING PRANE HIPOTEKES!
description_sq:

Per me shume info ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni! !
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 3+1+2 + VERANDA + PARKING NEAR THE MORTGAGE!

It is located on the sixth floor of a building under construction, it is in the facade stage (ventilated facade) and doors and windows. It is organized by a living and cooking area, three bedrooms, two toilets (with natural ventilation), a corridor, a 33.4m2 veranda, a storage room. A parking post is offered outside this value of the apartment. Perfect South-East orientation offering light and natural heating throughout the day and has a fantastic view of Tirana.
